description: Check that a service's x402, MCP, A2A and OpenAPI discovery surfaces are all present, well formed and HTTPS-consistent. Before publishing a service for agent discovery across x402, MCP, A2A and OpenAPI. Do not choose this when you need the live endpoints exercised, which needs a request. Example requests: Check my service's x402, MCP, A2A and OpenAPI surfaces for conformance. | Is my service ready for agent discovery? | Are my discovery documents consistent with each other? | Audit my agent commerce surface metadata.

accepted_price.description: The amount accepted, exactly as quoted (for example "5.00" or 5). Checked against the stored quote, so a price that moved between quote and authorize is refused rather than silently absorbed. Optional, but sent to make the acceptance explicit.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

a2a.description: The customer's a2a.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The A2A agent card. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

mcp.description: The customer's mcp.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The MCP server manifest. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

openapi.description: The customer's openapi.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The OpenAPI document. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

x402.description: The customer's x402.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The x402 discovery document. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by POST /v1/jobs. Required to authorize a priced capability; the service rejects a priced job that does not name the quote it issued.

name: submit_commerce_conformance_suite

access_token.description: Per-job credential. Present it as the X-Job-Token header to read the job or list it. Keep it; it is the only credential for this job.

verification.description: Independent verification. verification.ok = false means the job failed, not a partial success.

title: Agent commerce conformance suite
